description: 外部验证 tracker issue 创建证据门禁契约。该门禁消费 external validation tracker import package 和可选 operator 提供的脱敏 tracker issue evidence bundle，验证真实创建的 tracker issue 引用、body hash、workItemId 与 import package 逐项绑定。该门禁不创建 issue、不请求网络、不执行 gh、不证明 live proof 或第三方审计已完成。

executionPolicy.noNetwork: This gate must not call GitHub, gh, production API, HF Space, Telegram Bot, Postgres, OTel, IdP, SIEM, Vault, developer portal or third-party audit services.
executionPolicy.redaction: Evidence may contain sanitized tracker issue refs, labels, work item ids, issue template ids, body hashes, artifact hashes, createdAt and createdByRole only; it must not contain raw URLs, credential values, DSNs, webhook secrets, chat ids, payloads, user inputs or production logs.
executionPolicy.sourceBinding: Output must bind to tracker import package sha256, tracker import package kind and current commit.
executionPolicy.shipGate: Even when all tracker issue evidence is accepted, production live proof, certification and third-party audit gates remain blocked until their own evidence is supplied.

privacyBoundary: Tracker issue evidence gate 只保存脱敏 tracker issue ref、label、workItemId、issueTemplateId、body hash、artifact hash、createdAt、createdByRole 和 gate 状态；不得保存真实 URL、token、secret、DSN、webhook secret、chat id、外部账号、生产日志、trace payload、报告正文或用户输入。
nonClaims: Does not create issues in GitHub or any external tracker.
Does not execute gh or tracker CLI commands.
Does not execute external live checks.
Does not prove any external live validation has passed.
Does not create accepted proof refs by itself.
Does not mean FateCat is 100% production infrastructure.
